line.a_tama.text: Oh no, there's a hole in my dam! The water is escaping.

line.a_dziesiec.text: To mend it, I need ten logs.

line.a_licze.text: I'll count the logs! One, two, three...

line.a_dwanascie.text: Twelve! We have even more than we need!

line.a_dwa_razy.text: Mole, you counted some logs twice. When they lie in a heap, it's easy to get mixed up.

line.a_odkladaj.text: We put every counted log aside, into a row. Then none gets counted twice. Touch the logs one by one.

line.a_brakuje.text: Eight, and I need ten. Two more are missing.

line.a_ramka.text: I have a ten frame: two rows of five places. In it you see at once how many there are.

line.a_wloz.text: Drag eight logs into the frame.

line.a_piec_i_trzy.text: A full row is five. Five and three more is eight.

line.a_widze.text: I see! Two places are left to fill the frame.

line.b_las.text: We'll find more logs in the forest.

line.b_do_dziesieciu.text: Put logs into the frame until there are ten.

line.b_pelna.text: The frame is full. Ten is enough!

line.b_dziesiec.text: Two full rows of five make ten!

line.b_cyfry.text: And this is how we write these numbers.

line.b_cyfra10.text: And ten is written with two digits: a one and a zero.

line.b_skacz6.text: Mole, hop to the stone with the number six! Which one is it? Point to it.

line.b_skacz7.text: Mole, hop to the stone with the number seven! Which one is it? Point to it.

line.b_skacz8.text: Mole, hop to the stone with the number eight! Which one is it? Point to it.

line.b_skacz9.text: Mole, hop to the stone with the number nine! Which one is it? Point to it.

line.b_skacz_nie.text: Not that stone. Look at the numbers under the stones.

line.b_doskoczylem.text: Hop, hop, hop! I made it!

line.b_tama_gotowa.text: I've got ten logs. The dam will be whole!

line.c_tama.text: Here is my dam. Look, there's a hole in the middle and the water pours through it like a waterfall.

line.c_zatkamy.text: We have ten logs. Let's plug the hole with them!

line.c_licz.text: First let's check there really are ten. Point to the logs one by one. Each counted log goes into the row, so none is counted twice.

line.c_dziesiec.text: Ten logs! Each one counted only once.

line.c_do_tamy.text: Now into the dam! Five logs at the bottom and five on top, like in the frame.

line.c_zatkana.text: The hole is plugged! The water isn't running away any more!

line.c_koniec.text: My dam is whole again. Thank you! I couldn't have done it without counting.

line.p_start.text: Let's practise numbers up to ten! I have five games.

line.p_ile.text: How many pine cones are in the frame? Point to the number.

line.p_ile_nie.text: A full row is five. Count how many more are in the bottom row.

line.p_siedem.text: Put seven apples into the frame.

line.p_napisz.text: Write a seven with your finger. Start at the green dot.

line.p_wiecej.text: Where are there more acorns? Count and point.

line.p_wiecej_nie.text: Count again. A big heap doesn't mean more.

line.p_dziewiec.text: Which stone has the number nine? Point to it.

line.h_ile_palcow.text: There are five fingers on each hand. How many fingers do two hands have? Point to the number.

line.h_ile_palcow_nie.text: Five and five more. Count all the fingers.

line.h_dziesiec.text: Ten fingers! As many as the places in the frame.

line.h_rodzice.text: Count ten toys with your parents, putting them into the box one at a time!

line.naklejka_daj.text: Thank you for helping with the dam! Here is a sticker for your album. Touch it to take it.

line.naklejka_juz.text: You already have the sticker from this adventure. See you!

line.naklejka_opis.text: This is a log from Beaver's dam. We got it when we counted to ten.
